title: A retry storm, a team of two
text: A team of 2, two weeks. 600 requests per second, 3× for 10 s from 20 s; every hop retries 3 times, the retries choke the system, and it does not recover. Error rate ≤ 1% and p99 ≤ 300 ms for the whole run, at most $850 a month, at most 7 complexity points.
hint: More machines hold the load but go over the budget; a retry budget on every hop goes over the points. First remove the retries that multiply the load, then raise each API Server's concurrency a little (cheaper than another instance).
